mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the potato bay was most worthwhile: the skirt's distinction between light for shoots and darkness for tubers gave the construction a clear physical purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Planting the soybeans was straightforward but less developed than the potato and lettuce preparations; the offered compatible action left little decision-making.

surprise.text: The plain fabric became a passive wick, drawing solution up to the lettuce roots without another pump.

arbitrary.text: Combining foil and fabric initially felt like a guess because its crop-specific purpose was unclear; fitting it to the beds subsequently explained it.

continue.text: I would continue: the potato shading and lettuce wick made the practical details interesting, though the fast menu made choices fairly guided.
